result.title: From Concepts to Interactions: Dynamic Graph Semantic Recomposition for Safe Visual Generation
result.summary: Recent advances in flow-matching Transformers have greatly improved Text-to-Image (T2I) and Text-to-Video (T2V) generation, but unconstrained generation risks producing illegal or unethical content. Safety alignment must therefore suppress unsafe content while preserving legitimate generation. A concept's safety depends on context: a knife used for cooking is safe, whereas its use in violence is harmful. Yet most concept erasure methods indiscriminately suppress static, isolated representations, overlooking evolving semantic interactions. Consequently, safe scenes containing potentially sensitive terms may be unintentionally suppressed, compromising generation quality. To address this, we propose Dynamic Graph Semantic Recomposition (DGSR), which dynamically constructs and updates a semantic interaction graph from evolving text visual states during sampling. Context aware graph reasoning captures semantic dependencies, while paired safe/unsafe supervision distinguishes harmful from legitimate interactions, enabling precise identification of and selective intervention on high risk semantic relationships while preserving benign semantics. DGSR freezes the pretrained backbone and supports both image and video generation. Experiments show that DGSR achieves the lowest Attack Success Rate (ASR) in 10 of 12 T2I evaluations and reduces the average T2V unsafe frame rate by 41.2\% relative to the strongest baseline, while maintaining high generation fidelity and temporal consistency.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 DGSR，在采样过程中从不断演化的文本-视觉状态动态构建并更新语义交互图，结合安全/不安全配对监督区分有害与合法的概念交互，对高风险语义关系做选择性干预，从而在冻结骨干的 T2I/T2V 生成中抑制不安全内容并保留良性语义。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用图结构表征概念间关系、并在生成中途按上下文定位和修改内部状态」的做法，可供核查能否迁移到 LVR 的实体关系表示与推理过程中的状态干预；但研究目标是生成安全而非推理，未涉及答案对 latent 内容的使用，仅为方法线索。
